# Configuration

pfwd reads one TOML file. `pfwd config path` prints where it is: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/pfwd/config.toml` (usually `~/.config/pfwd/config.toml`) on Linux, `~/Library/Application Support/pfwd/config.toml` on macOS and `%APPDATA%\pfwd\config.toml` on Windows. `PFWD_CONFIG` or `--config` names another file.

Every setting is optional. `pfwd config edit` creates the file with every default and a comment on each line, and `pfwd config validate` reports unknown keys and bad values with their line numbers. The web UI's Settings page edits the common keys and the whole file. A running daemon uses a changed file after a restart.

## [detect]

| Setting | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interval` | duration | `"2s"` | How often to list the server's ports (at least 500ms) |
| `http_probe` | true or false | `true` | Check whether forwarded ports speak HTTP or HTTPS |
| `debounce_scans` | integer | `2` | Snapshots a new port must appear in before it is auto-forwarded |
| `ignore_ports` | list | `[22]` | Ports or ranges like "9000-9100": hidden, never auto-forwarded |
| `ignore_processes` | list | `["sshd", "systemd-resolved", "cupsd", "rpcbind", "containerd", "dnsmasq", "chronyd"]` | Their ports are hidden and never auto-forwarded |

## [forward]

| Setting | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auto` | true or false | `true` | Forward new ports automatically |
| `auto_ports` | list | `[]` | If not empty, only auto-forward these, e.g. ["3000-3999", 5173, 8888] |
| `bind` | string | `"127.0.0.1"` | Local address; anything else exposes forwards to your network |
| `on_conflict` | string | `"ask"` | When a local port is taken: ask, next, random or fail |
| `privileged_offset` | integer | `10000` | A local port below 1024 you can't bind moves up: 80 becomes 10080 (0 turns it off) |
| `auto_expire` | duration | `"10m"` | Drop auto-forwards whose port has been gone this long, unless pinned |
| `max_conns` | integer | `256` | Open connections per forward |
| `restore` | true or false | `true` | Remember forwards in state.json and restore them on connect |
| `allow_lan_socks` | true or false | `false` | Let a SOCKS proxy listen on a non-loopback address |

## [ssh]

| Setting | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `use_openssh_config` | true or false | `true` | Resolve hosts with "ssh -G" when OpenSSH is installed |
| `keepalive_interval` | duration | `"15s"` | Check the connection this often (ServerAliveInterval wins when set) |
| `keepalive_count_max` | integer | `3` | Reconnect after this many unanswered checks |
| `connect_timeout` | duration | `"10s"` | Used when the ssh config sets no ConnectTimeout |
| `reconnect_max_backoff` | duration | `"30s"` | Longest wait between reconnect attempts |

## [ui]

| Setting | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | string | `"auto"` | Auto, dark or light |
| `mouse` | true or false | `true` | Click a row to select it, scroll with the wheel |
| `confirm_quit` | true or false | `true` | Ask before quitting while forwards are active |
| `notifications` | true or false | `true` | Desktop notification when a port is auto-forwarded |
| `show_hidden` | true or false | `false` | Show ignored ports (toggle with h) |
| `glyphs` | string | `"auto"` | Auto, unicode or ascii |

## [labels]

Names for ports, shown next to them in the TUI and the web UI. Your labels win over the built-in ones (Vite on 5173, Postgres on 5432, Jupyter on 8888 and so on).

```toml
[labels]
8000 = "API"
```

## [hosts.NAME]

Settings for one host, matched against its ssh config alias. They override the ones above for that host.

| Setting | Type | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `auto` | true or false | Forward new ports automatically on this host |
| `auto_ports` | list | Only auto-forward these ports and ranges on this host |
| `forwards` | list of strings | Forwards that are always on and pinned, in pfwd fwd's syntax: `"5432"`, `"15432:db.internal:5432"`, `"-R 9000"`, `"-D 1080"` |

```toml
[hosts.devbox]
auto = false
forwards = ["5432", "15432:db.internal:5432", "-D 1080"]

[hosts.gpu-node]
auto_ports = [8888, 6006]
```
